newsitem.title: UK: MED OIL PRODUCTS MIXED - GASOLINE SEEN VERY TIGHT.
newsitem.headline: MED OIL PRODUCTS MIXED - GASOLINE SEEN VERY TIGHT.

text.p: Mediterranean oil products were mixed on Thursday, traders said.
Gasoline was still viewed very tight despite declines in the prompt market in the ARA area.
French refiners were seen unable to meet high demand levels from Spain, Italy and France as one Med refiner placed cargo values notionally $2 above NWE cargoes.
Gas oil was weaker by $2-3 a tonne in line with NWE. Premiums for Italian heating oil held around high fob quotes +$3.50-4.00.

Italian, Greek and Spanish sellers were reluctant to offer cargoes. Traders said increased contract business with airlines was sapping spot trade in a tigh market. Italian cargoes have been trading at high fob quotes +$7.00.
High sulphur fuel oil was quiet, notionally assessed steady to stronger around the $82/$83 fob mark on the offer side.
Traders said two buyers were looking for cargoes in a fairly tight market. Two ISAB stems of 25,000 tonnes each were said to be the only cargoes available at the moment.
High sulphur straight-run fuel was set to come under pressure once Iraqi crude starts hitting the market.
One precent was also inactive, with a major buyer said to be very relaxed at the moment.
